protocol_metadata.about: Save (formerly Solend) is an algorithmic, decentralized lending and borrowing protocol on the Solana blockchain, rebranded from Solend to Save Finance. Users can deposit crypto assets to earn interest or use them as collateral to borrow other assets, with interest rates set algorithmically. The protocol supports a global main pool and permissionless isolated pools, each with its own risk parameters. It is governed by the SLND token, whose holders can propose and vote on protocol changes including pool parameters, asset listings, and fee structures.
